name: aspectenant
description: Open-source, self-hosted business tenant and control plane for identity, administration and organisation-owned mailboxes.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/aspec/*" build && pnpm --filter @aspectenant/api build && pnpm --filter @aspectenant/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/aspec/*" typecheck && pnpm --filter @aspectenant/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @aspectenant/web typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
